subject: Base rate
key_relevant_findings: Bank Rate held 3.75% (6-3); CPI 3.1% Aug; BoE expects inflation slightly above 4% in 2027 Q1.

subject: Approvals, rates, consumer credit
key_relevant_findings: House-purchase approvals 56,100 (6-month avg ~60,800); remortgage 34,500; effective new mortgage rate 4.45%; consumer credit +£2.0bn.

subject: Lending volumes, arrears
key_relevant_findings: Outstanding £1,760.6bn (+3.1% y/y); gross advances £77.4bn (+31.7% y/y); commitments £79.2bn; arrears 1.1% of balances.

subject: High-LTV share, possessions
key_relevant_findings: >90% LTV share 8.4% (highest since 2008 Q2); new possessions 2,058 (-15.6% y/y).

subject: Forbearance
key_relevant_findings: ~22,400 mortgages had payments reduced via temporary IO or term extension in Q2 2026.

subject: Credit availability
key_relevant_findings: Lenders reported secured credit availability increased in 3 months to end-Feb 2026.

subject: Base rate history
key_relevant_findings: Rates cut 1.5pp in total Aug 2024-Dec 2025; CPI 3.1% Aug 2026.

subject: High-LTV scheme
key_relevant_findings: 2021 scheme closed to new accounts 30 Jun 2025; £600k property cap.

subject: Rates
key_relevant_findings: Avg 2-yr fix 5.92%, 5-yr 5.96% (25 Sep); big six repriced twice in Sept.

subject: Consolidation
key_relevant_findings: TSB integration via Part VII targeted H1 2027.

subject: Affordability regulation
key_relevant_findings: Lenders set own stress basis; 5-year horizon unless fixed 5+ years; no prevailing FPC recommendation.

subject: High-LTI lending
key_relevant_findings: Proposal to remove firm-level 15% limit while keeping 15% aggregate.
